title: Launch Enablement & Release-Notes Matrix for Per-Route Dashboards, Rollouts, and Cost Attribution
creator: Diego Ramos
description: Playbook to coordinate the launch of per-route dashboards, rollout controls, and cost breakdowns in the Console. This ticket captures the release-notes matrix, channel scripts for GTM, enablement sprints, training materials, and the cross-team orchestration checklist (Eng, Design, Support, Docs, Sales). Goal: smooth GA with clear troubleshooting guides and zero-surprise bill visibility for customers.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes drafted and approved by PM/Legal/Docs
Training slides and 45-minute live walkthrough scheduled with Support & Solutions
Per-route dashboard telemetry hooks verified in staging and smoke-tested
Rollout automation and canary policy documented and validated by ENG
Cost breakdown examples included in marketing collateral and API docs
rollout_steps: Week -3: Draft release-notes matrix and broadcast to stakeholders (Docs, Legal, Sales)
Week -2: Run internal feature demo; collect engineering runbooks and known limitations
Week -1: Freeze release notes; publish docs draft to staging; sign-off from Legal
Day 0: Canary deploy to 1% of accounts using rollout policy A; monitor latency and cost metrics
Day 0+1: Expand to 25% after threshold checks; run smoke test suite and runbooks
Day 0+3: Full rollout to GA if SLOs stable and no critical issues
release_notes_matrix: Matrix outlines customer-facing summary, technical details, migration steps, known issues, and sample API/Console screenshots. Each row maps a stakeholder (Support, Sales, Docs), required action, and owner. Example entry: 'Per-route cost breakdowns' -> Summary: per-route token and CPU cost estimates in Console; Action: update pricing FAQ and add sample queries; Owner: PM-Ava; PR: github.com/redwood/prs/4587
training_plan: Two-part enablement: 1) Pre-launch recorded demo (20min) + FAQ (docs) for Sales; 2) Live 45min training for Support & Solutions with hands-on ticket triage exercises. Training artifacts: slide deck, runbook, sample tickets. Trainers: Ava Chen (PM) & Jordan Patel (Eng). Post-training quiz to validate readiness.
